_notes: M37 spec v2 (2026-04-29 — restructured to align with paytable/Paytable-M37.md):
Reverse-engineered from rawdata/M37/mode_{1,2,5,7}/chunk_*.json + cross-checked
with paytable doc. Field analysis notes at slot_designer/tests/fixtures/M37_field_analysis.md.
Machine type — Classic 3-reel 1-payline + multi-tier wild on R2:
- Classic 1-line chassis (3x3 grid, middle row = sole payline)
- 5 wild types: wild (R1+R3, mult 1) + mini/minor/major/grand (R2, mult 2/5/10/100)
- All wilds substitute for non-blank symbols; final mult = base × ALL wilds' mult product
- NO feature engine (no ST=14/15, no bonus chain, no free spins)
=== Symbol-naming mapping (spec ↔ paytable doc) ===
Bar naming: paytable doc uses 'rank-from-top' (barN where N=rank), spec/rawdata
uses 'visual-stripe-count' (Nbar where N=stripes). They are INVERSE:
spec/rawdata 1bar (3× — lowest)  ↔  paytable doc bar3
spec/rawdata 2bar (4×)            ↔  paytable doc bar2
spec/rawdata 3bar (5× — highest) ↔  paytable doc bar1
spec/rawdata 7bar (6×)            ↔  paytable doc bar7
Multi-tier wild naming: paytable doc uses 'wildNx' (mult-explicit), spec/rawdata
uses 'mini/minor/major/grand' (jackpot-tier names). They are SAME symbols:
spec/rawdata mini  (R2, mult 2)   ↔  paytable doc wild2x
spec/rawdata minor (R2, mult 5)   ↔  paytable doc wild5x
spec/rawdata major (R2, mult 10)  ↔  paytable doc wild10x
spec/rawdata grand (R2, mult 100) ↔  paytable doc wild100x
spec/rawdata wild  (R1+R3, mult 1) ↔  paytable doc wild1x
spec encodes mini/minor/major/grand as kind:'booster' for engine path organization,
but their SEMANTIC behavior is wild-with-multiplier (substitute non-blank + mult).
=== Pay logic — paytable structure (by # of wilds on payline) ===
0 wilds on payline:
- 3-of-a-kind regular pay → pay_id 1-5 (high7/7bar/3bar/2bar/1bar = 10/6/5/4/3×)
- any-7 mixed (high7 + 7bar) → pay_id 6 = 2×
- any-Bar mixed (1/2/3/7bar) → pay_id 7 = 1×
- no match → 0
1 wild on payline (paytable single-wild rule = max of A/B):
A. direct: bet × wild_mult
B. substitute → highest-mult 3-match × wild_mult (multiplied)
Engine implementation:
- mid-wild (mini/minor/major/grand on R2) + R1/R3 form 3-match
→ pay_id 1-7 with multiplier × wild_mult (kind: line_3_same / line_3_group)
- mid-wild alone (no R1/R3 match) → pay_id 8 (grand 100×) / pay_id 9 (mini 2× / minor 5× / major 10×)
(kind: center_booster_alone)
- side-wild (R1 or R3) alone (no 3-match) → pay_id 9 = 1× flat (kind: side_wild_alone)
2 wilds on payline (paytable 2-wild rule = max of A/B):
A. substitute → 3-match × wild1_mult × wild2_mult
B. wild1_mult × wild2_mult direct (when 3rd is blank, only this applies)
Engine implementation:
- (wild, mid-wild, X) where X non-blank → A or B max via line_3_same/group with multipliers
- (wild, mid-wild, blank) → pay_id 9 = wild1 × wild2 effectively via center_booster_alone
3 wilds on payline (paytable Jackpot rule — FIXED, no substitution):
- (wild, mini, wild)  → pay_id 104 = 20×  (Mini Jackpot)
- (wild, minor, wild) → pay_id 103 = 50×  (Minor Jackpot)
- (wild, major, wild) → pay_id 102 = 100× (Major Jackpot)
- (wild, grand, wild) → REROLL-BLOCKED (see below); Grand Jackpot 1000× UNREACHABLE via 3-wild
Engine: kind: pure_wild_with_booster
=== Re-roll mechanic ===
(wild, grand, wild) on middle row is FORBIDDEN. Observed 0 hits in 2.14M rounds of mode 7
rawdata (expected ~3000 by natural rate) → real machine reroll-blocks this pattern.
Per paytable description, Grand Jackpot = 1000× would normally be the 3-wild path, but real
machine implementation overrides: 1000× top jackpot ONLY via high7-grand-high7 substitution
(pay_id 1 = 3-high7 base 10× × grand_mult 100 = 1000×, with grand substituting for high7).
Backend server-side re-draws (wild,grand,wild) spins; engine/spin.py mirrors this.
Max payout: 1000× via (high7|wild, grand, high7|wild) = pay_id 1 × grand_mult.

pays._note: (wild, major, wild) = high7 base x major = 100x
grand alone (no side match) has its own pay_id (jackpot UX tier)
wild on col 0 or col 2 (or both), no other match -> flat 1x

reroll_blocks.reason: prevent pure-wild path to 1000x top tier; forces grand-1000 through high7 anchor

extra_round_fields._note: ReelSkin field in each round = current mode number (1/2/5/7); emitter reads mode to populate it.
